event.description: Factor retained position table at highest compressive SVD rank 10
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Current retained frontier is 3,040 parameters at 99.850000%, a +0.850000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 2 prior attempts in this family. There is no accepted in-family result; the most recent failed result is attempt-0004, an optimization failure where a freshly trained direct 8D positional subspace reached only 9.35% validation before aborting, under the older separated-token architecture. Attempt-0023 in feed-forward width was also an optimization failure (width 9 reached 98.35% validation without checkpoint), so width 10 remains retained. Hypothesis: the trained positional table itself is approximately low-rank; its top 10 singular components retain 99.6198% of squared energy, and rank 10 is the highest rank that reduces position parameters (528->490), yielding 3,002 total. This representational compression is more informative than the nearest untested rank 9 because it tests the least lossy parameter-saving boundary and uses checkpoint SVD to separate approximation error from fresh-training instability.
